question_text:
Passage: The Philippine Health Insurance Corporation (PhilHealth) announced the expansion of its coverage for primary care services, effective January 2024. Under the new policy, all members, including indirect contributors, are entitled to a comprehensive outpatient benefit package that covers consultations, diagnostic tests, and preventive medicines at accredited primary care facilities. The package aims to reduce the financial burden of outpatient care and promote early detection of diseases. PhilHealth President Emmanuel Ledesma Jr. stated that the expansion is part of the Universal Health Care Law's implementation, ensuring that no Filipino is left behind in accessing essential health services.

Which of the following can be inferred from the passage?

options.text: Before 2024, PhilHealth did not cover any outpatient services.
The expansion is intended to improve access to preventive care.
Indirect contributors will have to pay higher premiums for the new package.
All primary care facilities in the Philippines are now accredited by PhilHealth.
